infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Mandi needs camera access to capture photos of received goods and dispute evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Mandi needs photo library access to attach evidence to receiving records and disputes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mandi uses your location to show delivery tracking relative to your outlet.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Mandi uses your location once, to place your outlet on the map so suppliers know where to deliver.
